sources.locator: Intro to access rules: column-specific rules, user.Access conditions, structure (S) permission warning
sources.observed: Column-specific rules supported; conditions use user.Access (EDITOR/OWNER/VIEWER) and row values; enabling rules reserves structure edits to Owners; S permission allows creating/changing formulas and since formula calculations are not limited by access rules, a user with S can retrieve any data / circumvent other rules.

sources.locator: License tiers: Business includes SSO, table/field permissions, teams; Scale adds audit logs, row-level security
sources.observed: Official purchase-license docs: Business = SSO, table- and field-level permissions, teams, external-app sync, single-provider AI. Scale = all of Business + unlimited workspaces, audit logs, row-level security, team hierarchy, multi-provider AI. Self-serve per-editor, 3-seat minimum on Scale.

Migration timeline: PG locks 2024.6, sessions to DB 2025.4, worker revamp 2025.8, cache/outpost/websocket 2025.10. Third-party notes: 2025.12 moved /media to /data; ~50% more PG connections.
